verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents connecting bank and credit-card accounts, plus PayPal and Square, with automatic transaction import ('we'll import your transactions for you'). Connector listings and PayPal import support this. Community mention of rule-based categorization indirectly confirms that imported transactions flow into QBO. Missing for 10: evidence of a daily or scheduled import cadence, independent hands-on corroboration of bank-feed reliability, and detail on supported institutions or the footnoted caveats on the claim.
